banners.0.p.0: There are no manual slots: only autosave and inn rest saves. Any mistake — the death of a quest NPC, a failed timer, a wrong choice — is recorded forever. The golden rule: sleep at an inn before any important quest — it creates a rollback point you can return to via "Load Game → Last Inn Rest".
banners.1.p.0: Some quests are timed, but the game never shows the timer. Time passes when you sleep at inns and houses, rest at campsites, "doze" on benches and ride oxcarts. The rules are simple:
banners.1.ul.0:
• Pick up a quest — do it right away, do not put it off "for later".
  • Do not sleep or sit on benches while a timed quest is active.
  • After finishing a quest objective, always talk to the quest giver to the very end — leaving the area early can mark the quest as "interrupted".
banners.2.ul.0:
• Wakestone — revives a dead NPC. If a quest giver dies, do not panic: find the body (city dead end up in the Charnel House) and revive them.
  • Ibrahim's shop (Checkpoint Rest Town) — buys back sold quest items and makes forgeries, which solve half of the game's "choice dilemmas".
  • Portcrystal + Ferrystone — place crystals at key points (near the Sphinx — mandatory!), saving hours of real time.
  • Struggling with a quest? Swap your pawns for fresh ones with quest knowledge — they will hint and guide you.
banners.3.ul.0:
• "Feast of Deception" — the coronation. Afterwards part of Vernworth's affairs "freezes" and Wilhelmina's quest gets a tight availability window.
  • The summit of Moonglint Tower (quest "Legacy") — the last chance to finish ALL side affairs of the old world. At the bottom of the tower — the final sweep.
  • The Dragon's choice — attack the Dragon (true ending) or walk away (false). Both branches are described in Act IV.
banners.4.p.0: Before entering Vernworth you should have closed: Ordeals of a New Recruit, The Provisioner's Plight, Medicament Predicament, Nesting Troubles, and ideally started Claw Them Into Shape and Spellbound. Next — the capital and the densest part of the game.
banners.5.p.0: 1) Seat of the Sovran → 2) Monster Culling (Scaly Invaders, Vocation Frustration along the way) → 3) The Heel of History → 4) The Caged Magistrate → 5) Disa's Plot → 6) The Stolen Throne → 7) An Unsettling Encounter → 8) The Nameless Village → 9) The Arisen's Shadow → 10) ALL remaining Vernworth & Melve side quests → 11) Every Rose Has Its Thorn (right after the coronation!) → 12) A Veil of Gossamer Clouds → and only then to Battahl.
banners.6.p.0: Before leaving south, check the checklist: Ulrika's route, Wilhelmina, The Arisen's Shadow, Saint of the Slums, Spellbound (grimoires), Gift of the Bow / A Trial of Archery, Till Death Do Us Part. Next — Battahl, and the way back will be long.
banners.7.h: The main rule of the Unmoored World
banners.7.p.0: The fog advances with every rest: after several nights, settlements start dying one by one. The plan of action: evacuate all five settlements as early as possible, starting with the farthest (Volcanic Island Camp, Excavation Site), and do not sleep unless necessary. Pawns and Purgen dragons ambush you on the roads — prepare your party.
banners.8.p.0: Saving all settlements awards "The Guardian" trophy. It requires all five evacuations + the trials of the Unmoored World. Sleep only when needed, move in a ring from the far settlements to the near ones — and everyone survives.
banners.9.p.0: After the 10th riddle, attack the Sphinx and shoot her with the Unmaking Arrow: one shot = auto-save, you cannot miss! Take the Key of Sagacity from her body and open the big chest: inside is the Eternal Wakestone — mass NPC revival, the best cure for the Dragonsplague. A normal fight is pointless: at low health she flies away forever.
ch.act1.lead: From the penal mine to the gates of Vernworth. Everything is laid down here: the first side quests, the first NPC fate branch and the first timed quest that players fail without even noticing.
ch.act2.lead: Vermund's capital is the heart of the game. The rules work like this: Captain Brant's tasks can be done in any order, side quests revolve around them, and the coronation ('Feast of Deception') is the first point of no return.
ch.act3.lead: Orange deserts, beastren and the most dangerous timers in the game. Order is critical here: pick up Shadowed Prayers and Prey for the Pack and close them instantly — hesitation kills the Empress and a child.
ch.act4.lead: The Giant walks out of the sea, the Dragon waits on the tower. Here it is decided which ending you get — and whether you leave for the true finale at all.
ch.act5.lead: The true endgame: red skies, drained seas and a limited supply of time. Ferrystones lie everywhere here, and every night of sleep brings the settlements closer to death.
ch.checklist.lead: Marks are synced with the quest cards above and stored in your browser. Everything checked off? You can face the Dragon with a clear conscience.
ch.missables.lead: Everything that can be lost forever on a single page. Check this table every time you are about to "push the story a little further".
ch.romance.lead: Two full romance routes — both are easy to lose. Both rewards are story-related, not checkboxes: close them in time.
ch.rules.lead: Dragon's Dogma 2 does not forgive inattention: a single save file, hidden timers and quests that fail silently. Read this to the end — and the game will never catch you off guard.
ch.sphinx.lead: The quest "A Game of Wits" starts at the Mountain Shrine (north of Checkpoint Rest Town). Main rules: do not attack the Sphinx until all riddles are done (she will fly away forever) and place a Portcrystal nearby — you will be doing a lot of running.
ch.vocations.lead: Ten vocations: four starter, two handed out almost immediately, four hidden in the world. Do not head into the finale without collecting them all.
footer.p.0: Compiled from open community guides (IGN, Polygon, PowerPyx, Fextralife wiki, Game8) and cross-checked against several sources. Quest names are given in localized form with the original English — search by the English name if your localization differs. Checklist progress is stored only in this browser.
footer.p.1: May the Rift watch over you, Arisen.
footer.title: Dragon's Dogma II · Walkthrough
hero.sub: A complete walkthrough: every quest in order, all branches, timers and points of no return — so you never miss a single line of content.
q.m01.body:
1. Create your character. Attention: body build affects running speed, grab reach and carry weight; changing race/body later is nearly impossible (until NG+).
  2. Follow Fisque and talk to Rook.
  3. Bring a stone block from the mine and place it next to Rook.
  4. Defeat the gorgon outside (learn to dodge the petrification).
  5. Run to the cliff after Rook and jump.
Do not miss: before the jump, search the camp — small supplies lie in the tents and will help at the start.
q.m01.title: 1. Chained Awakening
q.m02.body:
1. Follow the soldiers to the outpost, fighting off two packs of goblins on the way.
  2. At the Riftstone summon your first pawn and create your main pawn — it stays with you for the whole game.
  3. Rest at the Borderwatch Lounge.
Tip: give your main pawn a useful specialization (e.g. Woodland Wordsmith for Elvish translation — needed in two quests).
q.m02.title: 2. A Tale's Beginning
q.m03.body:
1. Head to the south-west gate of the outpost and go to the ravaged Melve.
  2. Watch the vision, talk to Ulrika, Gregor and Lennart.
  3. Escort Gregor to Vernworth: goblins and harpies on the road, a cyclops in the ravine.
  4. Activate the forgotten Riftstone along the way, then take an oxcart or walk.
Do not leave Melve without picking up the side quests below: "Medicament Predicament" and "Nesting Troubles" are taken right during this quest, and "Ordeals of a New Recruit" at the outpost has a hidden timer.
q.m03.title: 3. In Dragon's Wake
q.m04.body:
1. Talk to Captain Brant at the gates.
  2. Ask Norman about the runaway boy.
  3. Come to the Stardrop Inn at night and hear out Brant's plan.
  4. Receive three tasks: Monster Culling, Disa's Plot, The Caged Magistrate. He will add more later.
Brant is your handler until the end of the act. He meets at night in the Stardrop Inn.
q.m04.title: 4. Seat of the Sovran
q.m05.body:
Three monster hotspots, order is free:

  1. Trevo Mine (west) — clear it and grab the greatsword and archistaff: they are needed for the Vocation Frustration side quest (Warrior and Sorcerer unlock).
  2. Harve village — talk to Dylan, clear the cave of saurians and walk the guards out. The Scaly Invaders side quest is also taken here.
  3. East Vermund — drive goblins away from the guards.
  4. Return to Brant at night at the Stardrop.
On the way to the mine, stop by the Vernworth Charnel House — Wakestone shards lie there.
q.m05.title: 5. Monster Culling
q.m06.body:
1. Take the Eventide Mask from Brant.
  2. Follow the guard Sonya to the barracks inside the castle grounds.
  3. Climb to the upper floor and take the torn letter.
  4. Jump out of the window and return to Brant.
The castle enforces disguises: the mask plus evening wear answers most guard questions, but it is still better to stay out of forbidden areas.
q.m06.title: 6. Disa's Plot
q.m07.body:
1. Take the gaol key and the mask from Brant.
  2. Infiltrate Gaol Tower (through the castle yard), talk to Otto at its base.
  3. Open the first cell on the right — Waldhar is inside. He will not leave without a decent refuge.
  4. Finish The Heel of History and tell Waldhar about the found library.
  5. Walk him out of the tower and report to Brant.
After the quest Waldhar sits in the Gracious Hand storerooms — he gives the side quest A Magisterial Amenity and the grimoire Towering Earth for Spellbound / The Sorcerer's Appraisal.
q.m07.title: The Caged Magistrate
q.m08.body:
1. Get the formal set: the clothes lie in Allard's estate (noble quarter). Without a Courtly Tunic and Courtly Breeches you will not be let into the masquerade.
  2. Come to the masquerade at Vernworth Hall.
  3. Go through the secret passage in the rear part of the hall, along the balcony — to the Rose Chateau bordello.
  4. Peek through the peephole at the false Sovran and report to Brant.
Do not miss: keep the formal outfit — you will need it again for access to Myrddin (The Sorcerer's Appraisal) and the coronation.
q.m08.title: The Stolen Throne
q.m09.body:
1. Walk to the marker in the north-east; before the landslide, turn onto the right-hand trail.
  2. Climb the rocks past the minotaur.
  3. Talk to Sreyl at the entrance, then to Flod in the old noble estate.
  4. Go down the stairs into the Nameless Village Depths and run the obstacle course (traps + sparring bout).
  5. Talk to Flod, take 5 chests and report to Brant.
While you are here: Wendy at the village entrance will trade a forgery of the "Fulminous Shield" for the grimoire "Howling Blizzard" (needed for Spellbound).
q.m09.title: The Nameless Village
q.m10.body:
1. With Sonya again to the barracks, up the spiral staircase.
  2. Wait for Allard and Sias to leave the chambers (do not enter earlier!).
  3. Take the letter with the Battahl crest from the secret room.
  4. Jump out of the window; Wilhelmina will shield you from the guards — remember her, this is the start of her route.
q.m10.title: An Unsettling Encounter
q.m11.body:
The coronation of the false Sovran: almost pure cutscenes. Tell Brant you are ready, put on the formal outfit and follow him.

Before telling Brant "I am ready", make sure you have finished: The Arisen's Shadow, all Vernworth side quests from the list below, Ulrika's chain (Readvent of Calamity + Trouble on the Cape) and Beren's Final Lesson. After the coronation some city affairs change or disappear.
q.m11.title: Feast of Deception
q.m12.body:
1. Go to Checkpoint Rest Town. Humans need a border pass (issued by Brant) or a beastren mask from Ibrahim; beastren pass freely. Trick: you can hide in an oxcart.
  2. Cross the border and follow the road to Bakbattahl.
  3. Find Menella at the Rockmouse's Burrow.
On the way through the border, do not skip Checkpoint Rest Town: The Sorcerer's Appraisal, Hunt for the Jadeite Orb, Prey for the Pack and Mercy among Thieves are taken there.
q.m12.title: Nation of the Lambent Flame
q.m13.body:
1. Scout Bakbattahl and exit by the northern road.
  2. Talk to Ambrosius on the shore, gather shards of blue crystals.
  3. Visit the Bay Wayside Shrine — the Dragonforged (a smith; endgame gear is upgraded here later).
  4. Reverent Shrine — the oracle Luz: the conversation unlocks the Trickster vocation.
  5. Return to Harve and talk to the elder Rivage.
q.m13.title: Flickering Shadows
q.m14.body: Explore the temple risen from the sea near Harve, talk to the spirit Rothais and receive the Dulled Godsbane Blade. A short quest, but a crucial story branch.
q.m14.title: Convergence
q.m15.body:
1. Bring the Dulled Godsbane Blade to Ambrosius.
  2. Kill drakes and collect 15 Wyrmslife Crystals (drakes roam the whole world; watch for red glows on the map and pawn rumors).
  3. Optional — stop by Dragonsbreath Tower: Sigurd is there (if you missed him in Melve — a second chance at Mystic Spearhand).
  4. Hand in the crystals and return to Ambrosius the next day.
This is the last "calm" story quest. Before finishing it, close all remaining side quests of Vermund and Battahl — the final countdown begins next.
q.m15.title: A New Godsway
q.m16.body:
1. Pursue Phaesus through the Spellseal Door.
  2. The Giant walks across the map: you can cling to it and break the crystalline growths (or simply escort it).
  3. Scout the volcanic island and enter Moonglint Tower.
The summit of Moonglint Tower is the final sweep point. Before climbing, finish all side quests, the Sphinx riddles and the romance routes. After — only the finale.
q.m16.title: The Guardian Gigantus
q.m17.body:
1. Climb the tower, survive the attack of Phaesus's minions.
  2. The Dragon will offer a choice.
Choice 1: walk away (false ending)

Refuse the fight — the game shows the credits of the "normal" ending. The world stays as it is; you can load a save and choose otherwise.

Choice 2: accept the battle (true path)

Fight the Dragon. The key moment — the flight on its back: select the Empowered Godsbane Blade in your inventory and use it on yourself while flying. Hesitate or defeat the Dragon "honestly" — you get the normal finale. Apply the blade — the true ending opens: the Unmoored World.

After the false-ending credits the game offers to return to the choice — so you cannot go wrong forever, but you will lose time.
q.m17.title: Legacy
q.m18.body:
1. Look around: a world without water, new monsters, death without the old "checkpoint" revival.
  2. Go to the Forbidden Magick Laboratory and talk to Phaesus.
  3. Reunite with your main pawn in Bakbattahl.
q.m18.title: Dreams Apart
q.m19.body: Rothais and Luz give the main task: convince the residents of five settlements to evacuate to the temple. Five quests (order matters — start with the farthest):
q.m19.title: Halls of the First Dawn
q.m20.body:
1. Apply the Godsbane Blade to the red beacon in Bakbattahl.
  2. Follow Phaesus to the dragonferry vessel.
  3. Fend off waves of summoned monsters and smash the vessel.
q.m20.title: A Scholarly Pursuit
q.m21.body:
1. Return to the Giant's resting place — watch the fight with the Purgen dragon.
  2. Go to the last red beacon at the Seafloor Shrine and apply the Godsbane Blade.
  3. Dodge the Dragon's attacks — and watch the true finale.
After the credits NG+ opens: world, level, gear and pawn carry over; monsters and quests reset. The perfect moment to close what you missed (and with this guide — you missed nothing).
q.m21.title: When Wills Collide
q.s01.body:
Recruit Accardo is missing — he must be found. He lies wounded on a rock east of the camp (past the bridge, by the harpy nests). Climb up, fight off the harpies and carry him back.

Timed quest: if you go to sleep or leave the area for long, Accardo dies. Do it immediately.
Reward — 400 XP, 100 g, Lantern Oil
q.s01.meta.1: Condition: right after arriving at the outpost
q.s01.title: Ordeals of a New Recruit
q.s02.body: The outpost's quartermaster complains about missing supplies. The trail leads to the nearest goblin lair: clear it, take the cargo and return. A good excuse to level the party before the road south.
q.s02.title: The Provisioner's Plight
q.s03.body:
The local healer needs ingredients for remedies. Gather the requested herbs/fruits in the vicinity (everything grows right around the village) and return them. If an ingredient rots — buy a fresh one from a merchant or gather it again.

Tip: while in Melve, visit Dudley's shop — he sells the grimoire "Fulminous Shield" (5,000 g), needed later for the quests Spellbound and The Sorcerer's Appraisal.
q.s03.title: Medicament Predicament
q.s04.body:
Lennart asks you to destroy harpy nests around Melve. The nests are marked on the map; a bow or magick works best — harpies fly.

Reward — 400 XP, 1,250 g, Stoutness Extract
q.s04.title: Nesting Troubles
q.s05.body:
One of the brothers was taken prisoner by goblins nearby. Escort the second one to the lair, clear it and free the prisoner.

Reward — 400 XP, 1,500 g, Homespun Cloak
q.s05.meta.1: Condition: after starting Seat of the Sovran
q.s05.title: Brothers Brave and Timid
q.s06.body:
Instructor Beren is training recruits and asks you to bring weapons for practice, then to spar with his student. The camp lies on the hills west of the Melve–Vernworth road.

The quest opens a follow-up — Beren's Final Lesson (appears after Seat of the Sovran).
q.s06.title: Claw Them Into Shape
q.s07.body:
Trisha dreams of studying magick, but her grandmother Eini is against it. Trisha will ask you to bring five grimoires. This quest intersects with "The Sorcerer's Appraisal" — read both before handing in the books.

Where to get the 5 grimoires
  • Fulminous Shield — buy from merchant Dudley in Melve (5,000 g).
  • Towering Earth — from magistrate Waldhar (quest The Caged Magistrate, Gracious Hand storeroom library).
  • Let There Be Light — second floor of Myrddin's house in Checkpoint Rest Town (climb the outer wall so he does not notice).
  • Howling Blizzard — Waterfall Cave (north-east of Melve) or trade with Wendy in the Nameless Village.
  • Nation's Death Knell — the same chest in Waterfall Cave or the castle ruins at the Ancient Battleground.
The right call

Give Trisha the genuine grimoires (she will spot forgeries). Return a day later: Trisha loses control of her magick — do not attack her, just dodge until she tires out, then grab her. Return again the next day for the rewards.

Reward — Turquoise Ring, Cast Stone staff, Conjurer's Jottings (Sorcerer mastery Meteoron) and Enchanter's Almanac from Eini (Mage mastery Celestial Paean)
q.s07.title: Spellbound
q.s08.body: The guild clerk cannot issue the new vocations without sample weapons. Bring a greatsword and an archistaff — both lie in Trevo Mine (Monster Culling quest). Hand them in and Warrior and Sorcerer unlock for you and your pawns.
q.s08.title: Vocation Frustration
q.s09.body: Harve village is overrun by saurians. Clear all the marked spots and report to the villagers. This quest matters for Ulrika's route: it sets up the events of "Trouble on the Cape".
q.s09.title: Scaly Invaders
q.s10.body:
1. Give food to the beggar Kendrick twice.
  2. Talk to the three children nearby, then to Kendrick again.
  3. Find Malcolm in the Gracious Hand storerooms and follow him to the hidden library.
This quest is the key to "The Caged Magistrate": magistrate Waldhar will refuse to escape until you find him the library. Finish The Heel of History in advance to avoid running back and forth.
q.s10.title: The Heel of History
q.s11.body:
A hooded man — Bermudo — has been following you. Chase him down and grab him (the grab button). Then the choice:

Option A: take the bribe

Bermudo pays 5,000 g and disappears. The quest is finished, but you lose an extra story line.

Option B: refuse (recommended)

A fight begins. Do not kill him — grab and hold him until Brant arrives and arrests Bermudo. Talk to Brant a couple of days later: the interrogation gives extra dialogue and an improved border pass to Battahl.

If you accidentally kill Bermudo — revive him with a Wakestone or carry his body to Brant at night in the Stardrop. If you do not finish the quest before leaving for Battahl — it is gone.
Reward — up to 1,000 XP + 5,000 g (bribe) or story continuation
q.s11.title: The Arisen's Shadow
q.s12.body:
Donovan asks you to deliver a parcel. Take the job and set off right away: dawdling fails the quest (no heavy consequences, but the journal entry stays red).

Reward — 300 XP, 5,000 g, Miner's Hosen
q.s12.title: Oxcart Courier
q.s13.body: Mildred is looking for a caretaker for a house. After a short errand she will offer to sell it for 20,000 g — agree: this is your free "sleep" in the capital and, more importantly, the condition for Wilhelmina's letter in the Every Rose Has Its Thorn quest.
q.s13.title: A Place to Call Home
q.s14.body:
The girl Daphne gives flowers to the poor. Help her gather bouquets and deliver gifts. Completion opens the follow-up — House of the Blue Sunbright.

Reward — 900 XP, 100 g, Golden Trove Beetle (increases carry weight)
q.s14.title: The Gift of Giving
q.s15.body: The continuation of Daphne's story and the house she looks after. A simple, warm errand — done right near the slums; do not put it off for long.
q.s15.title: House of the Blue Sunbright
q.s16.body:
The beggar Albert lives suspiciously well. Wait for night, follow him to a house in the common quarter and take the beggar's tatters. Then — who to give the item to (one choice only!):

Give to Celina (wife at Walter's tavern)

A couple of days later Albert and Celina are found dead. Tragedy, 3,000 g + Noonbloom.

Give to Hilde (Baldwin estate)

Albert gives up his double life and becomes an honest citizen. Reward: 3 onyx.

Return to Albert

He pays 5,000 g for your silence and keeps living in two houses.
q.s16.title: A Beggar's Tale
q.s17.body: The elf Glindwyr admires human bows. Condition: you must be in the Archer class. Show him a bow and demonstrate your shooting at the marked spot. Unlocks the quest A Trial of Archery.
q.s17.title: Gift of the Bow
q.s18.body:
1. Meet Glindwyr at the camp south-west of Melve and escort him to Sacred Arbor (a chimera on the road — be ready).
  2. In the Ancestral Chamber Glindwyr will shoot an ogre in the arm — immediately run up and pick up Daryln (grab), carry her out while the others distract the ogre.
  3. You can finish the ogre — Glindwyr opens a shortcut; or simply carry the girl the long way.
  4. Talk to Taliesin outside.
If you fumble and hand Daryln to the ogre — she dies (bad ending for the quest). Save her first.
Reward — 2,800 XP, 16,000 g, Repeller Bow, Portcrystal; Taliesin teaches Heavenly Shot (Archer mastery). A pawn with the Woodland Wordsmith specialization translates the Elvish dialogue
q.s18.meta.1: Condition: after Gift of the Bow, a couple of days later
q.s18.title: A Trial of Archery
q.s19.body:
Margit asks you to look into a plot against her husband Gregor — the very knight from Melve. Follow the chain of objectives and intervene in the roadside ambush. If you delay — Gregor dies.

Reward — 2,800 XP, 5,000 g, Steeled Virtue, Lustrous Targe
q.s19.title: Till Death Do Us Part
q.s20.body:
1. Talk to Abbess Elena and bring 3 miasmite (mined from phantoms at night / bought).
  2. After the tour, talk to the patient Lyubomir and to Lottie.
  3. At night go down to the basement ward: take the treatment records and the unsigned medicine.
  4. Follow Elena's secret meeting with Alois at the well in the common quarter (night).
  5. Take the medicine to Doctor Radcliffe in Checkpoint Rest Town and wait for the analysis.
  6. Return and grab Elena in the basement (literally — with the grab button).
Outcomes

With evidence Elena is arrested for good; without Radcliffe's analysis she is released; you can also spook her at the meeting — then she flees.

Hidden post-quest: right after Elena's arrest tell Radcliffe to come (3,000 g) — otherwise Lyubomir dies. Reward: 10 Blighting Arrows.
Reward — 1,600 XP, 11,000 g
q.s20.meta.1: Condition: likely after The Heel of History
q.s20.title: Saint of the Slums
q.s21.body: A story around a shop with "special" goods: buy the box, then decide what to do with the merchant and his merchandise. An introductory quest to the forgery theme that will flourish in Checkpoint Rest Town.
q.s21.title: The Ornate Box
q.s22.body: The continuation of the shop line: delivering "special" correspondence. A small errand with variants; check your journal after visiting the shop.
q.s22.title: Masked Correspondence
q.s23.body: The sculptor Clark has lost his inspiration. Help him find his muse — a small quest that is easy to miss: just talk to him when passing the estates.
q.s23.title: A Case of Sculptor's Block
q.s24.body: The Vernworth smith confesses: true mastery remained in Battahl. A "deposit" quest — it continues as the chain Steeled Resolve, Blazing Forge already in Bakbattahl and ultimately leads to the elven smithy.
q.s24.title: Dulled Steel, Cold Forge
q.s25.body:
Waldhar has settled in the underground library, but cannot read without his glasses. Find his spectacles in the gaol tower / treasure room and return them.

Reward — 900 XP, the book Winter's Path
q.s25.title: A Magisterial Amenity
q.s26.body:
Return to Melve a few days later: a lesser dragon attacks the village. Strike the red boils on its body; when about 3 health bars remain, the dragon flies off.

Do not kill the dragon in Melve! Talk after the fight to the knight in red — Sigurd: he unlocks the Mystic Spearhand vocation. If you kill the dragon before talking to him, the spearmaiden's mastery can be lost until the very end of the game.
A few days later look into Ulrika's house — her personal line begins (Martin, fleeing to Harve).
q.s26.meta.1: Condition: a few days after Seat of the Sovran + Scaly Invaders
q.s26.title: Readvent of Calamity
q.s27.body: Ulrika in Harve argues with Jonas: a villager, Zoran, went missing at the cape. Descend into Stormlance Cave, clear the saurians and save Zoran. After the quest Ulrika returns to her role as village head.
q.s27.meta.1: Condition: during the Readvent of Calamity branch
q.s27.title: Trouble on the Cape
q.s28.body:
Lennart and Ulrika are rebuilding Melve. Help gather the villagers scattered across the world and set the village life going again. The finale of the chain is a scene that locks in Ulrika's romantic line.

Reward — 2,200 XP, 12,000 g, Ring of Reassurance
q.s28.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
q.s29.body: Beren received the order to disband the camp. Run the final training and sparring — a worthy farewell to the instructor.
q.s29.meta.1: Condition: Seat of the Sovran + Claw Them Into Shape
q.s29.title: Beren's Final Lesson
q.s30.body:
The most capricious quest in the game. The start works only like this:

  1. Right after the coronation go to the Rose Chateau and raise Wilhelmina's affinity to maximum: give bouquets (chest in her room) one per day until gifting becomes unavailable.
  2. Leave Vernworth and rest 3 days outside the city (an oxcart to Checkpoint Rest Town + a bench is a reliable method).
  3. Return at night: Rolf stands at her door. Enter her room and look through the peephole behind the painting.
  4. Offer help — you will have 3 days to gather evidence against Allard.
  5. Sven in the castle will direct you to Patrick (at night); he will lure Allard out of the estate. Inside — a painting, behind it the murder report.
  6. Show the evidence to Brant (night, Stardrop), then give it to Wilhelmina and choose "keep helping".
  7. On her signal enter and grab Allard; after the scene — escape through the window, get away from the guards, sleep at the inn.
  8. In the morning return to the Rose Chateau — a romantic scene and the end of the quest.
Fail to make it in 3 days — Wilhelmina is arrested and the romance is lost. Leave for Battahl / the Unmoored World before the start — the quest is unavailable.
Reward — 1,200 XP, 8,500 g, Ring of Benevolence
q.s30.title: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
q.s31.body:
Sven found a torn letter and asks you to find out its meaning.

Fast path

Show the letter to Waldhar in the Gracious Hand storerooms (requires finished The Caged Magistrate + The Heel of History): he recognizes a love letter. Smaller reward: 4,000 XP, 14,000 g.

Full path (recommended)

In Bakbattahl, in the Forbidden Magick Laboratory (Flamebearer Palace, stairs down), find the delivered letter to Lord Phaesus and bring it to Sven. Bigger reward: 4,000 XP, 20,000 g + Ferrystone.
q.s31.title: A Veil of Gossamer Clouds
q.s32.body:
Myrddin asks for the same five grimoires as Trisha (Spellbound). The solution — forgeries from Ibrahim (6,000 g per book, one day of work):

The optimal scheme

Give Myrddin the forgeries (at least 3 at once — then he will not notice) and Trisha the originals. This closes both quests and both mastery branches.

If you already learned Meteoron from Trisha — tell Myrddin the truth and show the Turquoise Ring (Trisha's gift): he softens and still gives the reward.
Reward — 11,000 g, Ares Morpho Robe, Myrddin's Chronicle (Sorcerer mastery Maelstrom)
q.s32.title: The Sorcerer's Appraisal
q.s33.body:
Two men are hunting a stolen orb. The orb is sold by Ibrahim (7,500 g); a copy is made there too (2,000 g). Before choosing, sleep at an inn:

Give to Offulve (beastren boy)

The "kind" finale: 3,000 g + Elite Camping Kit. You can also give him the forgery — same reward.

Give to Everard (original)

He will verify the orb with Ibrahim: 12,000 g + Ring of Skullduggery (backstab damage).

Cheat both

Forgery to Offulve, original to Everard: both rewards. You cannot give Everard the forgery without bribing Ibrahim (12,000 g) — you will go to prison.

Optimum: forgery to Offulve + original to Everard. The choice has no long-term consequences — only the rewards differ.
q.s33.meta.1: Condition: after Seat of the Sovran; Everard and Offulve will find you themselves
q.s33.title: Hunt for the Jadeite Orb
q.s34.body:
The boy Rodge is missing — dragged into the Cavern of the Forsaken. Do not sleep, do not wait — run right away: in the cave follow the flower "signposts", clear the monsters and lead Rodge out. A delay = his death.

Reward — 4,000 XP, 11,000 g, Miracle Roborant
q.s34.title: Prey for the Pack
q.s35.body:
1. Feed the boy Tumme by the road twice.
  2. Talk to the people opposite — they will point you to Lissandro.
  3. Lissandro asks you to find the Coral Snakes band. Travelers on the road will tell you where the lair is.
  4. One finale: the leader Lanzo betrays young Hugo, Hugo is arrested. This sets up the Off the Pilfered Path quest.
q.s35.title: Mercy among Thieves
q.s36.body:
Save Oscar at the ancient battlefield and help him with the rite at the belfry. While you are here — the grimoire "Nation's Death Knell" lies in the castle ruins, and the Sphinx lives to the north-east (see "Riddles").

Reward — 3,000 XP, 9,000 g
q.s36.title: Tolled to Rest
q.s37.body: An introductory quest to the city: getting to know Bakbattahl's districts and its ways. Do it right away — it opens the city activities and an understanding of the balance of power.
q.s37.title: Welcome to Battahl
q.s38.body:
An assassination is being prepared on Empress Nadinia. Menella gives a writ describing the killer (usually: a man with swept-back hair and a wounded right hand — but check your own writ!).

  1. Sleep until morning and come to the prayer.
  2. The search window is short: scan the crowd (photo mode helps). Look for a bandage/scar on the right hand; most often it is a man in a tunic at the right edge of the steps.
  3. Grab exactly that person — there is no second try.
Failure cascades: Nadinia dies, the quests A Candle in the Storm and Crossing in Shadow burn down, and the chance to buy a house in Bakbattahl is lost. Sleep at an inn before the prayer as a rollback point.
Reward — 3,500 XP, 18,000 g, 5 Jasper; the caught killer gives intel on the Coral Snakes (5,000 g bribe in prison)
q.s38.meta.1: Condition: after Nation of the Lambent Flame
q.s38.title: Shadowed Prayers
q.s39.body: A city line about suspicious potions and their dealer. Hear out the client in the city, follow the chain and decide the merchant's fate. A small but atmospheric quest about Battahl's mores.
q.s39.meta.1: Condition: after Nation of the Lambent Flame
q.s39.title: A Poisonous Proposal
q.s40.body:
The merchant Isaac's eyesight is failing and he asks for a ripe quince, and then — the second volume (definitely not cursed) of a grimoire. The volume is sold by Ibrahim.

Give the real grimoire

It ends badly: Isaac's shop closes.

Give the forgery

Isaac's and his family's life returns to normal. Ibrahim makes the forgery.

The choice affects one of the outcomes of the Off the Pilfered Path quest (Hugo's arrangement).
q.s40.meta.1: Condition: after Nation of the Lambent Flame
q.s40.title: Short-Sighted Ambition
q.s41.body: The smithing chain continues: Sara and Brokkr will help bring back the old forging quality. Run their errands — the quest matters because it introduces Sara, the key figure of the elven line (The Ailing Arborheart).
q.s41.title: Steeled Resolve, Blazing Forge
q.s42.body:
1. Talk to Daryln in Sacred Arbor: the Arborheart is fading, the remedy "gwyfencha" is needed.
  2. A pawn with the Woodland Wordsmith specialization translates the Elvish and points the way; without one — through Gaustad's house.
  3. The trail leads to Brokkr's smithy in Bakbattahl: Sara will trade the remedy for a Nutriabh dish — return to Daryln.
If you do not heal the Arborheart before the Unmoored World, the evacuation of Sacred Arbor in the Wandering Roots quest ends with the death of the elves.
q.s42.meta.1: Condition: after A Trial of Archery and Steeled Resolve, Blazing Forge
q.s42.title: The Ailing Arborheart
q.s43.body:
1. Escort Daryln to Sara — she will take you to Straggler's Cave outside the city.
  2. Gather scalecinder — green piles of dust all over the cave; smash crates. Time is limited, the goal is at least 6 portions.
  3. Hand the scalecinder to Daryln — the Arborheart will be healed.
Reward — 13,000 g, Warbler Capelet; the restored Arborheart (condition for saving the elves in the endgame)
q.s43.title: Out of the Forest, Into the Forge
q.s44.body:
Acasus asks you to deliver a plea letter from Ernesto to the camp on Agamen Volcanic Island. The road is long and dangerous — combine it with the quests around the volcanic island.

Reward — 2,500 XP, Ferrystone, 20,000 g
q.s44.title: 'Twixt a Rock and a Hard Place
q.s45.body: At night an oxcart that should not exist rides the highway. Investigate the rumors, find the "phantom" cart and uncover an underground scheme with pawns. Take a night outfit and stock up on Ferrystones.
q.s45.meta.1: Condition: after Nation of the Lambent Flame
q.s45.title: The Phantom Oxcart
q.s46.body:
Sir Augustin's escort is interrupted by an attack: Ragnall shouts that the guardsman Simeon is a murderer and that you are the patsy. The choice is made by attacking the side you are against (even a grab counts as a hit!):

For Ragnall (recommended)

You will cut down the guards and leave with him into Guerco Cave: learn the truth about the plot. Ragnall will remember this — important for Clash and Conclusion and his final event.

For Simeon

Ragnall flees with Augustin; catch up with him in the same cave. Rewards are identical, only Ragnall's attitude changes.

Reward — 4,000 XP, 12,000 g (either way)
q.s46.meta.1: Condition: after Nation of the Lambent Flame
q.s46.title: Tensions on the Highroad
q.s47.body: At the next masquerade a nameless noble will ask for a "delicate" favor. A short social quest — drop by the masquerade when you are in Vernworth during this story period.
q.s47.meta.1: Condition: between Nation of the Lambent Flame and A New Godsway
q.s47.title: A Noble Exchange
q.s48.body: Menella keeps guarding Nadinia: the plot is not fully uncovered. Escort them and deal with the remaining threat. Successful completion together with "A Place to Call Home" opens Crossing in Shadow.
q.s48.title: A Candle in the Storm
q.s49.body: A night operation: help those the law forbids cross the border. A quiet, dangerous run — go at night, avoid patrols and mind your lantern.
q.s49.meta.1: Condition: after A Place to Call Home and A Candle in the Storm
q.s49.title: Crossing in Shadow
q.s50.body:
1. Give the dwarf Gaustad 3 any herbs (stock up in advance).
  2. Walk him home — meeting his wife Cliodna.
  3. Escort Gaustad to the Geyser Hamlet hot springs (Volcanic Island Camp).
  4. At the springs Cliodna appears — the conversation unlocks the Magick Archer vocation; talk to her again before she leaves to immediately get the mastery Martyr's Bolt.
A bottle of Newt Liqueur lies on the table in Gaustad's house — take it for The Sotted Sage quest.
q.s50.title: Put a Spring in Thy Step
q.s51.body:
The drunk Lamond by the bathhouse asks for 3 bottles of Newt Liqueur:

  • craft: Fruit Wine + Saurian Tail (tails are cut from saurians);
  • buy from Erland in Bakbattahl (2,000 g);
  • take from Gaustad's house (quest Put a Spring in Thy Step).

Hand over all three — Lamond reveals himself and unlocks the Warfarer vocation + the mastery Rearmament.

Reward — 980 XP, 500 g, Warfarer vocation
q.s51.title: The Sotted Sage
q.s52.body:
1. Visit Hugo in Bakbattahl prison, exhaust the dialogues.
  2. Talk to the inmate Brefft: it turns out Hugo's parents were killed by his mentor Lanzo (hiding at the Ancient Battleground).
  3. Tell Hugo. The next day he escapes, kills Brefft, and goes for revenge.
  4. Find Hugo at the Ancient Battleground and help him in the fight with Lanzo.
  5. Afterwards — help Hugo settle in: the options depend on your past deeds (to Sara at the smithy — if Tolled to Rest and the smithing chain are done; to Isaac — if you gave the real grimoire; etc.).
The quest is timed: do not abandon it halfway or Hugo's line concludes without you.
q.s52.title: Off the Pilfered Path
q.s53.body: During the Giant's march Ragnall will find you — the finale of his story with Simeon. If you want Ragnall to survive and stay your ally until the end of the game, choose his side here too.
q.s53.meta.1: Condition: Tensions on the Highroad done on Ragnall's side
q.s53.title: Clash and Conclusion
q.s54.body:
Convince the volcanic camp residents to evacuate: talk to Ernesto and the key inhabitants (Gaustad, Cliodna, Lamond — everyone you helped). While you are there — kill the local Purgen dragon.

Reward — 20,000 XP, 40 Wyrmslife Crystal, 15,000 g
q.s54.title: The Importance of Aiding Ernesto
q.s55.body:
The evacuation of the penal mine: help the pawns get out and bring Enrique the Diminished Godsway. This is where you started the game — a pleasing symmetry.

Reward — 20,000 XP, 30 Wyrmslife Crystal, 15,000 g
q.s55.title: Shepherd of the Pawns
q.s56.body:
The elves will leave only together with their sacred Arborheart. If you finished The Ailing Arborheart and Out of the Forest, Into the Forge — the tree survives the move. If not — the elves perish with it. Talk to Taliesin and organize the departure.

Reward — 20,000 XP, 30 Wyrmslife Crystal, 25,000 g
q.s56.title: Wandering Roots
q.s57.body:
A riot in Bakbattahl: calm the city together with Menella and Nadinia and convince the residents to evacuate. As everywhere — grab the local Purgen dragon on the side.

Reward — 20,000 XP, 30 Wyrmslife Crystal, 10,000 g
q.s57.title: Civil Unrest
q.s58.body:
1. Bring Disa to Sven.
  2. Intimidate Allard (or deal with him) and take what is needed for the evacuation.
  3. Organize the capital's move to the temple.
Reward — 20,000 XP, 35 Wyrmslife Crystal, 25,000 g
q.s58.title: The Regentkin's Resolve
q.s59.body: The first five riddles are at the Mountain Shrine (free order). Then the Sphinx moves to the Frontier Shrine — find her there (Reunion riddle) and get four more in random order.
q.s59.meta.1: Condition: find the Sphinx; the quest disappears after Legacy
q.s59.title: A Game of Wits
riddle.0.answer: Answer: in the cave by the shrine there is a chest right above the entrance — take the Sealing Phial from it and give it to the Sphinx. Do not drink the phial and do not drag other chests!
riddle.0.name: Riddle of Eyes
riddle.0.text: "Pass through the door and bring back that which is most precious."
riddle.1.answer: Answer: place on the pedestal the character with maximum affinity. The easiest — your main pawn: hoist them onto your shoulder, set them by the pedestal and talk to the Sphinx. A Portcrystal placed here will help with the remaining riddles.
riddle.1.name: Riddle of Madness
riddle.1.text: "Bring me the one you love most of all."
riddle.2.answer: Answer: hire a pawn in the Rift nicknamed SphinxParent / SphinxMother / SphinxFather (search at the Riftstone of Fellowship — e.g. near Harve or behind the Ancient Battleground; check the creator — Capcom). Bring them to the Sphinx.
riddle.2.name: Riddle of Wisdom
riddle.2.text: "I am a lost child. Bring me my parent."
riddle.3.answer: Answer: any item works — the Sphinx returns its copy. Give something rare and expensive: the best choice is a Portcrystal.
riddle.3.name: Riddle of Conviction
riddle.3.text: "Give me that which you value most."
riddle.4.answer: Answer: return to where you picked up your very first Seeker's Token at the start of the game — a Finder's Token appears at that spot. You have 7 in-game days. Don't remember the place? Recall: for most it is the nest on the hill near Melve or the Borderwatch surroundings.
riddle.4.name: Riddle of Rumination
riddle.4.text: "Where did you find your first Seeker's Token?"
riddle.5.answer: Answer: simply find the Sphinx at the Frontier Shrine (north-west of Checkpoint Rest Town) and talk to her.
riddle.5.name: Riddle of Reunion
riddle.6.answer: Answer: knock the opponent off balance, pick them up and throw them off the cliff behind the columns. Remove the ring after the fight! The Ambition ring speeds up XP gain.
riddle.6.name: Riddle of Contest
riddle.6.text: A duel, but with the Ring of Derision — your damage is nearly zero.
riddle.7.answer: Answer: this is Dante or Vergil — two nearly identical NPCs in Checkpoint Rest Town. Dante: straight hair and an even scar (at the entrance, Vermund side); Vergil: wavy hair and a jagged scar (behind the gates, Battahl side). Check History → NPC Logbook, hoist the right one and teleport to the Sphinx.
riddle.7.name: Riddle of Differentiation
riddle.8.answer: Answer: the trick — deliver not the amphora to Maurits, but Maurits to the amphora: find him at the Mural Byway in Bakbattahl, grab him and teleport to the Portcrystal at the shrine, then place him next to the amphora (not on it!). The Eternal Bond ring sharply boosts affinity with any NPC.
riddle.8.name: Riddle of Futility
riddle.8.text: "Deliver a fragile amphora to Sir Maurits in Bakbattahl." It breaks from any hit; teleporting is forbidden.
riddle.9.answer: Answer: carry exactly as many statues to the pedestal as riddles you have solved correctly (usually 9, if this is the last one). The Reunion riddle counts too.
riddle.9.name: Riddle of Memory
riddle.9.text: "How many riddles have you already solved? Show me with statues."
sec.act1.h3.0: Side quests of the act — in order of completion
sec.act2b.h3.0: Vernworth and surroundings — all side quests in order
sec.missables.h3.1: Other things that are easy to miss
sec.missables.p.0: Failure is not always fatal, but it almost always cuts off rewards, quest chains or NPC lives.
sec.missables.tip.0: Tip: before story "turning points" (coronation, departure to Battahl, Moonglint tower) return to this table and to the checklist at the end of the guide — run your eyes over the open items.
sec.romance.tip.0: Affinity: grows from quests and gifts (almost everyone loves bouquets). A character at maximum affinity is handy for the Sphinx's Riddle of Madness, and the Eternal Bond ring (Riddle of Futility) instantly strengthens relations with any NPC.
sec.vocations.tip.0: Quest masteries: Heavenly Shot (Taliesin, A Trial of Archery) · Meteoron (Trisha, Spellbound) · Celestial Paean (Eini, Spellbound) · Maelstrom (Myrddin, The Sorcerer's Appraisal) · Martyr's Bolt (Cliodna, Put a Spring in Thy Step) · Rearmament (Lamond, The Sotted Sage). The Warfarer class wields any weapon and combines skills — ideal for the endgame.
tbl.0.r.1.1: Vernworth, Donovan at the northern oxcart station
tbl.0.r.1.2: No serious consequences, but the quest fails
tbl.0.r.3.2: The boy Rodge dies in the cave
tbl.0.r.4.2: Empress Nadinia dies; failure of "A Candle in the Storm" and "Crossing in Shadow"; cannot buy a house in Bakbattahl
tbl.0.r.5.2: Wilhelmina romance unavailable; she goes to prison. The quest window closes as the story progresses
tbl.0.r.6.2: Miss the start of Ulrika's route and meeting Sigurd in Melve
tbl.0.r.7.0: Out of the Forest, Into the Forge
tbl.0.r.7.2: Short timer for gathering scalecinder in the cave
tbl.1.r.0.1: Ignore "Readvent of Calamity" when the dragon attacks Melve
tbl.1.r.0.2: The moment you see the event in Melve — go there immediately; then the chain Trouble on the Cape → Home Is Where the Hearth Is
tbl.1.r.1.1: Fail or miss "Every Rose Has Its Thorn"; leave for the Unmoored World
tbl.1.r.1.2: Do the quest right after "Feast of Deception", before leaving for Battahl
tbl.1.r.2.1: Attack her before solving all 10 riddles; miss with the Unmaking Arrow
tbl.1.r.2.2: Do not touch her with weapons until the finale; save at an inn before the 10th riddle
tbl.1.r.3.1: Kill the dragon in Melve before talking to Sigurd
tbl.1.r.3.2: Drive the dragon off (remove ~3 health bars), then talk to Sigurd
tbl.1.r.4.1: Too many nights of sleep: the fog swallows settlements one by one
tbl.1.r.4.2: In the endgame sleep as little as possible and evacuate settlements immediately
tbl.1.r.5.1: Walk away from the Dragon fight in "Legacy"
tbl.1.r.5.2: On the Dragon's back, use the Godsbane Blade on yourself (details — Act IV)
tbl.1.r.6.1: Do not heal the Arborheart before the Unmoored World
tbl.1.r.6.2: Finish The Ailing Arborheart and Out of the Forest, Into the Forge before the finale
tbl.1.r.7.1: Leave for Battahl without waiting for/catching the spy in Vernworth
tbl.1.r.7.2: Walk around Vernworth's trade quarter until Bermudo finds you himself
tbl.2.r.1.1: Vocation Frustration: bring a greatsword and an archistaff from Trevo Mine (or simply find such weapons)
tbl.2.r.2.1: Talk to Sigurd during Readvent of Calamity in Melve (do not kill the dragon first!) or at Dragonsbreath Tower
tbl.2.r.3.1: Talk to the oracle Luz at the Reverent Shrine (quest Flickering Shadows)
tbl.2.r.4.1: Put a Spring in Thy Step: herbs → Gaustad → escort to the hot springs → Cliodna
tbl.2.r.5.1: The Sotted Sage: 3 bottles of Newt Liqueur for Lamond at the Volcanic Island Camp
tbl.3.r.0.1: Readvent of Calamity → scene at her house → Trouble on the Cape → Home Is Where the Hearth Is
tbl.3.r.0.2: Do not ignore the dragon attack on Melve; do not drag out the gaps between stages; close the whole chain before the end of the game
tbl.3.r.1.1: Meeting in The Stolen Throne / An Unsettling Encounter → maximum affinity (bouquets) → Every Rose Has Its Thorn
tbl.3.r.1.2: The quest has a 3-day timer; take it right after Feast of Deception; a house in Vernworth (20,000 g) unlocks her letter and the final scene
